newsitem.title: UK: Marks plans more stores in Germany, Spain.
newsitem.headline: Marks plans more stores in Germany, Spain.

text.p: Marks & Spencer Plc said on Tuesday expansion in Germany will depend on the availability of sites, but the group would like to open in Dusseldorf, Frankfurt, Essen and eventually Hamburg.
Deputy chairman Keith Oates said the company was actively looking and negotiating for sites and concentrating initially on the Rhine/Ruhr region.
Sales at the group's first German store in Cologne, which opened in October, have exceeded estimates, he told a news conference.
The retailer also plans to double the number of stores in Spain over the next two years. It already has two stores in Madrid, as well as one in Seville, Barcelona and Valencia.
Oates said the group would open additional stores in Madrid and Barcelona plus a store in Bilbao.
The first new Madrid store will open in March 1997 and a second in September. Bilbao will open in spring 1998 and negotiations are underway for the new outlet in Barcelona.
Marks currently trades from 640 locations in 31 countries, including franchise operations.
